en: Welcome to Motostoke Stadium! Here to register for the gym challenge? Your endorsement, please.
{player} handed over the Champion's letter of endorsement.
From Leon himself! Wonderful. You're registered. Welcome to the challenge!
And me too! Same letter, same brother. We're real challengers now!
Endorsed by the Champion, are you? I was endorsed by Chairman Rose himself.
A challenger chosen by the chairman needs no luck. Try not to get in my way. It would be embarrassing for you.
What's his problem? Never mind. The ceremony's tomorrow, so we've a room at the hotel on the lower terrace. Come on!
Challengers, this way! The ceremony is about to begin. Through the tunnel and out onto the pitch!
Kabu's gym mission is the third of the challenge. Come back with the Grass and Water Badges and he'll test you!
Welcome to Motostoke Stadium, home of Kabu's gym and of the opening ceremony!
